projects.source: FTUSA Premium project (sample data, fictionalized) PROJ-4074B8A8
projects.name: Agricultural Salt for Soil Enhancement
projects.challenge: The Premium participants cannot buy Agricultural salt as fertilizer of the coconut trees to improve or enhance soil fertility to increase farm production
projects.action: Fertilizers improve the supply of nutrients in the soil, directly affecting plant growth. Soil amendments improve a soil's physical condition (e.g. soil structure, water infiltration), indirectly affecting plant growth and productivity. Moreover, fertility has an impact on activities with an economic impact and is therefore related to economic growth and the fight against poverty.
projects.intended_outcome: 204 Fair Trade Premium Farmers are the beneficiaries of this project to to enhance the fertility of the soil thru application of Agricultural salt as fertilizer to coconut trees to increase productivity resulting to the increase of the income of Premium participants or the farmers.

projects.name: Distribution of Agricultural Salt
projects.challenge: Farmers income from the coconut is not enough to sustain the daily needs because of unproductive coconut tree due to poor fertilization of coconuts
projects.action: When crops are harvested, the nutrients follow the crop. Important nutrients are therefore removed from the soil. Often the soil is not able to replenish all the nutrients by itself, that is where fertilizers are crucial in supplying the nutrients that are lacking. In turn, this maximizes crop yield and quality. Fertilizers are key to rejuvenating the soil by providing nutrients the plants need to grow healthily either organic or non organic fertilizers.
projects.intended_outcome: To increase the income of the Premium participants or the farmers by using of fertilizers because it enhances crop productivity or increases the volume of coconuts.

projects.source: FTUSA Premium project (sample data, fictionalized) PROJ-2713E03E
projects.name: GOOD PRACTICE. AGRICULTURAL - PD 2021
projects.challenge: Coffee production and the management of productive units are causing negative impacts to the environment that cause damage to biodiversity, the ecosystem and human health. This is mainly due to the lack of interest of producers in nature conservation and to the lack of knowledge of actions for better management of productive units to minimize the problem. This situation occurs in 80% of our partners' farms.
projects.action: This program seeks the production of environmentally sustainable coffee by certifying farms. The sustainability of coffee farming is promoted through the adoption of good agricultural practices, a series of tasks that are carried out on farms for the care of nature, conservation of biodiversity and preservation of human health. For this purpose, training is provided to producers where they are made aware of the importance of BPA and the benefits they bring to their environment.
projects.intended_outcome: The program was intended to encourage more environmentally friendly coffee cultivation, preserving biodiversity and seeking ecosystem well-being; this was possible thanks to the certification of some farms where good agricultural practices were implemented. This certification meant the producer an extra income from the sale of their coffee and the provision of elements for personal care while carrying out hazardous work on the farm.
